title: EQUIPPED FOR
THE DAY AHEAD
end: The Morning Altar — begin every sunrise in prayer
stock_queries: golden sunrise mist over mountain valley
soft morning light through sheer white curtains
dew drops on green leaves at dawn
abstract sun rays filtering through trees

scenes.a: That sharp knot of dread in your chest is not your burden to carry alone.
Finally, my brethren, be strong in the Lord, and in the power of his might.
Put on the whole armor of God, that ye may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil.
Father, replace this frantic energy with the steady rhythm of your peace.
Help me walk through the challenges of this day with courage that comes from you.
May my heart remain tethered to your truth as the world starts its noise.
